nodes.label: Filesystem MCP Server (not adopted)
nodes.rationale: No filesystem-based corpus exists yet — ingestion is in-memory ingestion/seed_data.py; revisit if ingestion moves to reading real files off disk.

nodes.label: Postgres MCP Server (not adopted)
nodes.rationale: No database exists; retrieval/engine.py is fully in-memory. Revisit only if corpus scale outgrows in-memory BM25/TF-IDF.

nodes.label: Web-Search MCP Server (not adopted)
nodes.rationale: Redundant with the built-in web-search tool already scoped to ingestion-authoring-time-only per docs/PLUGINS.md; a dedicated MCP server would add standing surface with no new capability.

nodes.label: Context Trimming Policy (Step 8)
nodes.rationale: Summary+recent-turns split keeps each sub-agent's state file bounded (summary ~12-15% of context budget, last 8-10 turns retained) so context doesn't grow unbounded across long sessions; triage log is exempt because it's already compact append-only audit history.

nodes.label: Delegation Policy (Step 7)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator routes tasks to scoped sub-agents by file-scope rather than implementing itself, and requires triage review before every commit, to enforce isolation and consistent commitment checking.

nodes.label: Harness Note: sub-agent files not auto-registered
nodes.norm_label: harness note: sub-agent files not auto-registered
nodes.rationale: In this SDK-based environment, .claude/agents/*.md are not auto-registered as Agent-tool subagent_types (a Claude Code CLI-only feature), so delegation must be simulated via a general-purpose agent instructed to read and follow the target role file.

nodes.label: Plugin/Tool Strategy (Step 10)
nodes.rationale: code-review skill adopted for general correctness alongside triage's domain-specific commitment checks; web-search reserved strictly for ingestion-time candidate-source discovery, never query-time, to avoid bypassing the allowlist commitment.

nodes.label: Deferred Gap: escalated Status Dead Code
nodes.norm_label: deferred gap: escalated status dead code
nodes.rationale: Deferred because no cheap, well-defined trigger for conflicting cross-source-type evidence exists in the 7-doc POC corpus; revisit once a real corpus or concrete conflicting-evidence test case exists.

nodes.label: Allowlist-Only Retrieval (Commitment 1)
nodes.rationale: Documents outside the allowlist must never reach generation; retriever filters to approved:true before ranking to prevent unapproved sources influencing answers.

nodes.label: Claim-Level Grounding (Commitment 2)
nodes.rationale: Every generated sentence must resolve to a citation in the allowlist; an unresolvable citation is invalid output, not a warning, to guarantee auditability for legally-challengeable claims.

nodes.label: Cross-Domain Browsing (Commitment 5)
nodes.rationale: Browsing by source_type is a standalone, list-only exploration mode separate from query/answer, still respecting the allowlist, so users can explore the corpus without triggering generation.

nodes.label: Fail Gracefully (Commitment 4)
nodes.rationale: When evidence/confidence is insufficient, refuse or escalate instead of fabricating, to avoid unsupported claims in a pharma/legal context.

nodes.label: Source Registry Expectations
nodes.rationale: version/superseded_by fields required to catch version drift across multi-source ingestion (literature, patent, clinical_trial, internal_report).

nodes.label: Structured Output (Commitment 3)
nodes.rationale: Free-text answers are treated as a bug; fixed schema keeps downstream consumers (UI, MCP tools) able to rely on a consistent contract.

nodes.label: Design Choice: Grafana via OTLP collector
nodes.norm_label: design choice: grafana via otlp collector
nodes.rationale: Grafana picked as the more common bring-your-own-collector target; SigNoz would work identically since both ingest OTLP. Exporter env-var selectable (otlp/console/none) so the POC stays testable without external infra.

nodes.label: Tool Substitution: locust instead of k6
nodes.norm_label: tool substitution: locust instead of k6
nodes.rationale: k6 isn't installed and would require adding a new APT repo (system-level change); user chose locust instead since it's pip-installable with no system changes.
